final: WITH invoice_stats AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_product_cost, AVG(1.0 * derived_total_cost / NULLIF(product_price, 0)) AS ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM invoice_stats) SELECT AVG(avg_product_cost) AS avg_product_cost, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(ratio - overall.avg_ratio) AS avg_excess_ratio FROM invoice_stats CROSS JOIN overall WHERE ratio > overall.avg_ratio
